title.narrative: Progress in construction of new hospital as per category 5 plus specifications

Impact of extreme weather conditions on hospital services (admissions, referrals, surgeries)
Emergency Disaster Preparedness Plan and Evacuation Plan implemented according to procedures
Progress in essential upgrades to the existing hospital
Updated clinical guidelines for prevalent health problems implemented and evaluated
Contingency Plan in place for continuous services during works and reallocation of services
Emergency Disaster Preparedness Plan and Evacuation Plan updated
Number of additional hospital beds to manage and treat COVID-19 suspected and confirmed patients.
Hospital implemented a triage and treatment system including split services between COVID-19 and non-COVID-19 patients
